messages:
Lena Park: Customer requested route-level cost leaderboard + error-slice drilldown. We need to split demo scope vs full launch. Quick opinions?

Eliot Moss: For demo: org-level leaderboard (top10 routes), trace link, estimated cost column. Backend effort small. Full launch adds per-region and accuracy improvements.

Sam Patel: Estimates: leaderboard UI ~3d, trace plumbing ~2d, cost tag backend ~3d (migration). Error-slice explorer is larger (4-5d).

Riya Gupta: UX: keep demo read-only, columns = Route | Est Cost % | 95p Latency | 5xx rate | Trace. Tooltip explaining "estimated" needed.

Arjun Singh: Ops: canary sampling flag only; no auto-rollback. Add alert if 5xx delta >0.8% over baseline within 30m.

Lena Park: Customer acceptance asks: leaderboard accuracy >=85% top-10, trace links resolve >=95% for samples, query latency <2.5s. OK?

Eliot Moss: 85% is reasonable if we label as estimated. We'll expose coverage metric in footer.

Sam Patel: Plan: Sprint A (canary/demo): leaderboard + trace links + estimated badge. Sprint B: attribution improvements + error-slice detail + per-region opt-in.

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2025-03-13 02:00-04:00 UTC. :rocket:

Lena Park: Action items: Sam create PRO-601 (Demo leaderboard), PRO-602 (Sampling flag), Riya provide mock, Arjun draft runbook. I'll book demo for 3/29.

Riya Gupta: Mock + sample dataset uploading to PRO-601 today.

Sam Patel: Locking demo scope if no objections: org-level leaderboard (estimated cost + 95/5xx + trace link), sampling flag, coverage footer. :thumbsup:
